messages:
maria_g: Heads-up 5 were running a focused social push for the benchmark webinar. Need final owners for assets, copy, UTM tagging, and lead routing. Goal: 400 signups, route high-intent leads to SDRs in <30m.

olivia_marketing: Ill write two X headlines + a LinkedIn long post. Can also make 10s teaser clips if we can record speaker intros.

jake_p: Ill create 1200x675 hero and 1080 square. Send logos and stat PNGs. Will export transparent overlays.

sam_ops: Routing plan: Drift captures signup -> HubSpot enrich -> if lead.score >= 45 AND submitted_via=="social" then assign to `sdr_hot` and post to #sales-inbound with lead details. Otherwise tag `webinar_cold` and nurture. Please confirm form id.
tom_sales: SLA 30m for hot leads. Ill publish SDR rota and quick reply snippets (pricing, dedicated, security). Need the tracker link to confirm notifications.
ad s-bot: Paid boost suggestion: test $800 split 70/30 X/LinkedIn. Recommend lookalike on signups.

maria_g: Good. Cadence proposed:
Mon 9:30am X (stat card + CTA)
Tue 12pm LinkedIn (long post + customer quote)
Wed 11am X thread (3 posts)
Thu 2pm X reminder (clip)
Fri 10am LinkedIn final nudge
All links must include ?utm_source=social&utm_medium=x_or_linkedin&utm_campaign=webinar_may2026

olivia_marketing: Short copy options:
1) "We reduced inference cost 3.8x. Hear how in our webinar. Register: <link>"
2) "Benchmark: latency vs cost tradeoffs explained. Join engineers on May 18. RSVP: <link>"
Which should be primary?

maria_g: Use (1) as primary test. (2) as variant. Jake tag assets `bench_primary` and `bench_variant`. Sam add pixel: rdw_px_web2026 and ensure UTM tracking.

sam_ops: Pixel added. HubSpot form id recorded as `f9c2-web-2026`. Ill build workflow and post YAML link here.

jake_p: Deliverables: hero PNG, square PNG, 15s clip (no audio), overlay PSD. Aiming for EOD.

tom_sales: Preparing reply library and rota; will post by tomorrow AM.

maria_g: Action items: Jake assets (EOD), Olivia schedule copy (tomorrow AM), Sam implement routing & Slack alerts (EOD), Tom SDR rota & reply lib (tomorrow AM). Review at 3pm in #marketing-ops. :thumbsup:

olivia_marketing: Will upload drafts here when done.

sam_ops: Workflow draft posted: internal/doc/link. Will ping when live.

maria_g: Thanks team. Ping if blockers.
